'''Waleutto Yobariok's protocol droid''' was a gold-plated [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] belonging to the eccentric merchant [[Waleutto Yobariok]]. The droid was eventually left in the basement of [[Waleutto Yobariok's estate]].<ref>{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Treasure Hunting|Extravagant Possessions}}</ref>
